title: Replay Machine Serialization
statement: For every effective code system $c$ for two-work-tape nondeterministic binary machines, there are a finite-state deterministic binary machine $M$ and a function $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every binary string $\alpha$, $M$ computes in time $T(|\alpha|)$ the fixed serialization of the deterministic replay machine obtained from the machine decoded from $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is an effective code system for two-work-tape nondeterministic binary machines
replaced:
For every effective code system for two-work-tape nondeterministic binary Turing
machines, there exist a finite-state deterministic binary Turing machine $M$ and a
time-bound function $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every binary string
$\alpha$, $M$ halts within $T(|\alpha|)$ steps and outputs the fixed serialization of
the deterministic replay machine associated with the machine decoded from $\alpha$.
